The workbook generation failed because critical data cells in the 'Task' sheet were empty (None) instead of containing the expected calculated values.
The verifier failed with AssertionError in test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats. Specifically, cells H12:L17 (top block) and H35:L40 (net metric) returned None instead of the expected numerical values. For example, 'H12: expected 612.5, got None' and 'H35: expected 4.499999999999997, got None'. This indicates a failure to correctly populate or calculate the matrix values in the 'Task' worksheet.
